continuation: Resume the same native optimizer/RNG/scheduler across registered stages while finite and within the spending/deadline limits. Development failures motivate diagnosis; they do not choose the final checkpoint.
selection: Lowest sample-weighted physical arm MSE over the frozen 200 held-out frames; ties choose fewer recovery updates. Gripper error and ten development rollouts are diagnostics, not final-test selection. Report uncertainty and failures.
retention: Keep the latest two native checkpoints and the checkpoint with lowest held-out arm MSE. Hash and retain compact provenance for pruned checkpoints. Final export verifies model and complete resume state before rental deletion.
scope: Separate recovery study. Correct image rescaling; last four decoder layers trainable; fresh optimizer; increased data exposure. Original RSI source, journal and scores unchanged. Native tiling, data/split, normalization, action/world architecture, losses and prediction semantics unchanged.
